subject.title: [Feature]: Telegram Business Bot support (business_message / business_connection updates)

question: Should bundled Telegram support include Telegram Business personal-DM handling now, and what account-scoped business_connection_id authority model should it use?
rationale: The requested feature matches a major-channel gap, but it expands personal-DM access and outbound authority after a prior implementation was closed for Telegram-owner direction and security/routing blockers.

options.title: Approve bounded support
options.body: Implement support in the bundled Telegram plugin with per-account durable Business connection state, disconnect cleanup, Business-aware dedupe/sequencing, docs, focused tests, and live Telegram proof.

options.title: Defer until owner design
options.body: Keep this issue open as the design tracker and do not queue another implementation until a Telegram owner defines the Business access-control and outbound-authority contract.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded support
recommendation.body: Implement support in the bundled Telegram plugin with per-account durable Business connection state, disconnect cleanup, Business-aware dedupe/sequencing, docs, focused tests, and live Telegram proof.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc provided the most direct current owner-direction signal by closing the earlier Business implementation PR and has recent Telegram seam history.
